topic: Server-to-server: when to use it and its documented limitations
queries: server-to-server KST implementation
backend KST tracking without JavaScript
can I track sales without browser scripts
is server to server supported
do I need a dev team for server to server
what support is there for server-to-server
we'd rather not use browser JavaScript at all
content:
Kelkoo Group publishes clear limits on this method:

- GTM or manual installation is the **official** implementation. Server-to-server is intended only as a **fallback** to increase tracking coverage — not a replacement.
- It is only available if you have an **in-house development team** managing it. It is not suitable for agencies, third parties, or merchants without a technical team.
- Kelkoo Group does **not** provide custom implementation, and provides **very limited technical support** for this method.
- You must track inbound traffic directly from the Kelkoo Group Network, as well as parallel tracking calls when the URL contains a `gclid` from Google.
- You must ensure all sales are tracked — both in-session, and those made in a different session from the initial click.

Workload is estimated at a **minimum of 5 days** of development for an experienced developer.

topic: Server-to-server: how the flow works end to end
queries: how does server to server tracking work
how do I store kelkooId and gclid in my database
server side Kelkoo tracking flow
what do I save when the user lands on my site
associate click id with basket and login
KST API integration overview
content:
The flow Kelkoo Group documents:

1. A user browsing Kelkoo Group websites clicks an offer and is redirected to your site. The KelkooId (`kk`) and Google Click Id (`gclid`) are passed as URL parameters, for example:

   `https://www.acme.com/miror/137-miror.html?kk=a4csscc-1781b717420-34cf3&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIpNXu6r6D6AIVQsjeCh27SQXcEAkYAyABEgIhz_D_BwE&utm_source=kelkoofr&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=kelkooclick`

2. When the user reaches a product page, your backend stores `kk` and `gclid` in a table and associates them with the current user via login/basket:

basket | login | kk | gclid
17e8b1bxx7r17420 | 1233443 | a4csscc-1781b717420-34cf3 | EAIaIQobChMIpNXu6r6D6AIVQsjeCh27SQXcEAkYAyABEgIhz_D_BwE

3. When the user buys and reaches your confirmation page, your site retrieves the stored `kk` and `gclid` values and calls the Kelkoo Group Sales Tracking webservice at **https://s.kelkoogroup.net/st** with an HTTP GET, once per sale.

If you use an external tracking service (such as Lengow) you must add the parameters into the merchant landing page URLs — Lengow short URLs, for example, are not compatible. As a best practice, add `"Referer: https://yourwebsite.com"` to the request header of the call.

queries: what parameters does the tracking webservice take
server to server API parameters
what is comId
what is productsInfos
what is saleId
what is the msclkid parameter
how do I encode the products for the webservice
required parameters for the sales tracking call
content:
The webservice at `https://s.kelkoogroup.net/st` is called with an HTTP GET taking these parameters:

name | type | mandatory | description | example
country | String | true | The 2-letter country code for the country on which your products are listed on Kelkoo Group: | fr
orderId | String | true | A unique order identifier | FAPC-MZL8-QFNY
comId | Long | true | The unique ID representing your shop within the Kelkoo Group system | 100503562
orderValue | Double | true | The total amount of the order | 37.72
productsInfos | String | true | A UrlEncoded Base64 of a Json Array of the products in the basket. | W3sicHJvZHVjdG5hbWUiOiJTaGltYW5vIiwiaWQiOiJwcm9kMTMwODIzIiwicHJpY2UiOjE0Ljk5LCJxdWFudGl0eSI6Mn1d
saleId | Double | true | A randomly generated number between 0 and 1 | 0.24603935101497432
kelkooId | String | false | The value of the kk parameter in the url of your landing page | a4c6224-1700767fb9f-c3de3
gclid | String | false | The value of the gclid parameter in the url of your landing page | EAIaIQobChMIpNXu6r6D6AIVQsjeCh27SQXcEAkYAyABEgIhz_D_BwE
msclkid | String | false | The value of the msclkid parameter in the url of your landing page | 751ff8c7d3bf17f6f6729c640c4249d5
returningUser | Boolean | false | "true" if the sale is done by a returning user, "false" for a new user | true
source | String | false | Set this param value to "serverToServer" | serverToServer

Note `comId` here is the merchant ID (called merchantId elsewhere in the docs).

Decoded and pretty-printed, `productsInfos` looks like:

```
[
  {
    "productname": "Shimano", // string
    "productid": "prod130823", // string
    "price": 14.99, // double
    "quantity": 2 // integer, floating number is not allowed here
  }
]
```

Note `quantity` must be an integer — floating point numbers are not allowed.

queries: example server to server call
what does the tracking URL look like
sample GET request to s.kelkoogroup.net
show me a full example call
how do I format the tracking request
content:
A full example call from the documentation:

```
https://s.kelkoogroup.net/st?country=fr&orderId=CMD0572084&comId=100475501&orderValue=609.07&&saleId=0.193286593627784&kelkooId=66b5837-16afefa0c40-1b540&source=serverToServer
```
section_heading: What exactly do you need to implement ?

queries: consent for server to server tracking
GDPR server side Kelkoo
who manages consent for server to server
does the cookie banner cover server to server
privacy for backend tracking
content:
For a server-to-server integration, consent must be managed **directly by the merchant** — it is not covered by the traditional cookie consent mechanism the browser-based tags rely on.

See the GDPR Notice for Kelkoo Sales Tracking for the underlying data processing detail.
